{{recipesummary|category=Soup recipes|servings=2}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* ½ loaf dry [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]]
* 750 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] puréed tomato
* 1–2 [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] cloves, crushed and finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Oil]]
* 1 handful of well-ripped [[Cookbook:Basil|basil]] leaves
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste

== Procedure ==
# Dip the bread in water for a short time, so that you can crush it with your hands. It should not be soaked.
# [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] the garlic in a large [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] with oil until it begins to change color.
#Add the tomato purée and salt, and cook over medium heat until it comes to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
#Add pieces of bread in, none smaller than a walnut, after wringing and continue to mix it with the tomato, until it has become completely red.
#At this point the tomato should still have a fresh aroma.
#Remove from heat and serve hot in a bowl, seasoned with a drizzle of olive oil, pepper and a basil leaf.

quantityCandidate.sourceText: 1–2 garlic cloves, crushed and finely chopped

steps.text: Dip the bread in water for a short time, so that you can crush it with your hands. It should not be soaked.
Fry the garlic in a large frying pan with oil until it begins to change color.
Add the tomato purée and salt, and cook over medium heat until it comes to a boil.
Add pieces of bread in, none smaller than a walnut, after wringing and continue to mix it with the tomato, until it has become completely red.
At this point the tomato should still have a fresh aroma.
Remove from heat and serve hot in a bowl, seasoned with a drizzle of olive oil, pepper and a basil leaf.
